equation_or_rule: pore_frac = N(pore pixels) / N(all pixels)  [Delesse: area frac ~ volume frac]
limitations: only pores >= ~0.13 um equiv. diam counted; true porosity incl. sub-resolution is ~0.25-0.40 (assumed add-on)
sensitivity_to_recipe: low-robust across threshold sweeps; shifts with flat-fielding
downstream_use: DFN porosity (plus assumed sub-res 0.15-0.30); swelling budget term

equation_or_rule: pores_per_mpx = N(pore objects >= 20px) / (N_px / 1e6)
worked_example: img_4ih2ggld: 196.0; Batch_3 median 108.3; B1-B3 diff +34.5 (exact p=0.0005)
limitations: rises with image noise (rho~0.91 with noise_mad) - use noise-adjusted version; NOT a DFN input
sensitivity_to_recipe: medium - sensitive to noise and min-size floor
downstream_use: none in the DFN; image-level finding only

equation_or_rule: pores_raw - [6.18*noise_mad + 54.6] + ref_median_pores (fit on Batch_3 only, R2=0.51)
limitations: correction model itself is noisy (R2~0.5); still correlated with raw count (rho~0.85)
sensitivity_to_recipe: medium - depends on the reference-only regression
downstream_use: none

equation_or_rule: sum(area of objects kind=si_particle) / N_px
increase_means: more silicon-family material classified as particles
limitations: inherits threshold AND classifier choices; NOT chemical identity - EDS needed
sensitivity_to_recipe: medium-high - the bright/uncertain boundary moves with t_core
downstream_use: DFN Si active share (lo bracket = this x accessible share)

equation_or_rule: sum(area of objects kind=bright_fine) / N_px
increase_means: more ambiguous bright material (fines, rims, or low-contrast Si)
limitations: category defined by OUR classifier, not by physics; report together with si_candidate_frac
sensitivity_to_recipe: high - membership moves with t_core and contrast
downstream_use: DFN Si active share (hi bracket counts ALL of it as Si)

equation_or_rule: N(bright pixels above t_si) / N_px before object classification
increase_means: more bright material of any kind
limitations: conflates particles with edges/fines/tinted binder; naive 'all bright = Si' reading is what overcounts
downstream_use: diagnostic; qc pipeline used this as 'Si'

equation_or_rule: median of eq_diam = sqrt(4A/pi) over si_particles, weighted by area
limitations: 2-D sections under-read 3-D size (~0.785x Saltykov); watershed over-splitting biases down
sensitivity_to_recipe: medium - sensitive to watershed and classifier
downstream_use: DFN Si particle radius = D50/2

equation_or_rule: area-weighted 90th percentile of eq_diam
limitations: few large objects dominate; sensitive to border handling and splitting
downstream_use: cracking/pulverization risk interpretation; not a direct DFN input

equation_or_rule: R = mean_NN_dist / expected_NN_dist(random); R<1 clumped, R~1 random, >1 spaced
limitations: structurally forced <1 when Si sits inside graphite pockets; two pipelines disagree on convention (r=0.32)
downstream_use: interpretation only; not a DFN input

equation_or_rule: mean distance-transform from pore mask over Si-boundary pixels
worked_example: Batch_1 0.53 vs Batch_3 0.62 um (micro2dfn; clear diff)
limitations: 2-D proximity, not 3-D wetting; boundary-pixel convention varies between pipelines
downstream_use: interpretation of dead Si; scales into accessible share

equation_or_rule: share of si_particles with <5% of boundary within ~75nm of a pore
increase_means: more silicon poorly connected to pores
limitations: runs high (~0.7-0.99) everywhere - relative comparison only; 75nm contact band is a convention
downstream_use: scales si_accessible_frac -> DFN Si share lo bracket

equation_or_rule: mean horizontal pore chord / mean vertical pore chord; >1 = pores lie flat
increase_means: flatter pores -> longer through-plane ion path
limitations: could be real calendering texture or ion-milling curtaining - undecided; orientation is relative to image frame
downstream_use: interpretation only (directional marker, no DFN input)

equation_or_rule: share of pore objects with aspect>3 oriented >30 deg from foil
limitations: may partly reflect polishing/pull-out artefacts; 2-D morphology only, not propagation
downstream_use: supporting diagnostic only

equation_or_rule: area of biggest connected pore component / total pore area
worked_example: Batch_1 0.040 vs Batch_3 0.057 (clear diff, bootstrap CI excludes 0)
limitations: 2-D connectivity only; a section can slice through connected 3-D networks
downstream_use: supporting diagnostic for the pore finding

equation_or_rule: budget = pore_frac - 2.8*Si_frac - 0.1*bulk_frac
decrease_means: expansion demand exceeds visible pore space
limitations: DERIVED from the same pore+Si measurements - NOT independent evidence; assumes 280% Si / 10% Gr volume changes
downstream_use: interpretation only (cited risk band), not a DFN input

equation_or_rule: max over discharge steps of X-averaged negative secondary particle surface tangential stress /1e6
worked_example: B1-B3 paired median -0.81 MPa (meaningful per declared rule); B2-B3 -1.59 MPa
limitations: model-dependent: driven mainly by active-Si share (Spearman rho~-0.93 in the sweep), NOT particle radius; stress is in-cycle peak not rest value
sensitivity_to_recipe: high - depends on E, nu, Si share assumptions
downstream_use: a compared DFN indicator (declared threshold 0.5 MPa)

equation_or_rule: discharge-step counter difference on last of 5 x 1C cycles
worked_example: B1-B3 +0.099 Ah; B2-B3 +0.150 Ah - both BELOW declared 0.25 Ah threshold
limitations: NOT measured cell performance; spread of the 17-run assumption sweep (~1.16 Ah IQR) dwarfs batch differences
downstream_use: a compared DFN indicator (threshold 0.25 Ah)

equation_or_rule: min over all time of X-averaged negative electrode surface potential difference
worked_example: reference cell min = +0.0115 V; batch runs dip slightly below 0
limitations: a WARNING only counts where the reference stays >=0 V; sub-0 in this protocol is a protocol/geometry artefact
downstream_use: plating-margin indicator (threshold 0.01 V)

equation_or_rule: max over discharge steps of Cell thickness change x 1e6
worked_example: batch medians ~12.3-12.5 um on ~75um electrode; all pairs below 0.5um threshold
limitations: electrode thickness itself is assumed (65-85um); peak during discharge, not rest
downstream_use: a compared DFN indicator (threshold 0.5 um)

equation_or_rule: (I_si - I_pore) / (I_bulk - I_pore) on raw intensities
limitations: GUARD: tells you whether the comparison is trustworthy, not material quality
downstream_use: gates interpretation of all Si metrics; problem-photo flag when low

equation_or_rule: 1.4826 * MAD(raw - Gaussian(raw, 2px)) on bulk pixels
limitations: guard; drives the pore-count noise correction (r~0.91 with pores_per_mpx)
downstream_use: noise adjustment of pore counts

equation_or_rule: var(|Laplacian|) over bulk pixels
limitations: nearly perfectly correlated with noise_mad here - redundant pair
downstream_use: acquisition QC only

equation_or_rule: b = 1 - ln(tau_2dproxy)/ln(eps), clipped [1,3]; default 1.5 if degenerate
increase_means: steeper transport penalty per porosity loss
limitations: heuristic calibration from a 2-D geodesic proxy; resolved pores never percolate in 2-D so tau_fdm is not measurable
downstream_use: DFN Bruggeman coefficient (swept over band)

equation_or_rule: Crofton stereology: S_V = (4/pi) * boundary intercepts / area
limitations: assumes boundary counting is unbiased by segmentation
downstream_use: reported; can scale SEI exchange current (reported only)

equation_or_rule: d_mean_area-weighted / (2*0.785)  (Saltykov sectioning correction)
limitations: spherical-particle assumption; estimate of 3-D from 2-D sections
downstream_use: DFN Secondary particle radius (swept over D50 band)

equation_or_rule: 1 - share of Si objects with zero pore contact
limitations: defined by the 75 nm contact-band convention; 2-D only
downstream_use: scales the lo end of the DFN Si-share bracket

equation_or_rule: PyBaMM LLI variable at end of 5 cycles
limitations: cannot move measurably in 5 cycles - DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, excluded from comparison
downstream_use: none in the verdict - deliberately excluded

equation_or_rule: 100 * cap(last) / cap(first) over 5 cycles
limitations: cannot move measurably in 5 cycles; >100% reflects model transients - DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
downstream_use: none in the verdict - deliberately excluded

equation_or_rule: usable anode capacity / usable cathode capacity from stoichiometry windows
limitations: computed, not measured; cathode thickness rescaled per run to hold the REFERENCE N/P
downstream_use: geometry audit - kept meaningful across assumed anode geometry

equation_or_rule: ASSUMED 75 um, swept 65-85
worked_example: foil & coating top never in frame
limitations: not measurable in these images at all - a declared assumption, swept
downstream_use: DFN input + N/P rescale

equation_or_rule: resolved porosity + 0.15-0.30 (literature band, swept)
limitations: entirely assumed - pores below ~0.13-0.35 um are invisible
downstream_use: DFN Negative electrode porosity

equation_or_rule: lo = classified Si x accessible share; hi = ALL uncertain bright as Si
limitations: a deliberate bracket on label uncertainty - NOT a measured value
sensitivity_to_recipe: very high - it is the uncertainty, expressed
downstream_use: DFN Secondary AM volume fraction

equation_or_rule: FIXED at 5.86 um (Chen2020), identical for every batch
limitations: fixed assumption - deliberately NOT measured (flakes are not spheres)
downstream_use: DFN Primary particle radius

csv_column: si_youngs_pa / Secondary: Negative electrode Young's modulus [Pa]
equation_or_rule: 50 GPa default, swept 35-90 (Bonkile2024 cited range)
limitations: borrowed constant, not measured on this material
downstream_use: DFN mechanics (stress-LAM coupling)

csv_column: si_nu / Secondary: Negative electrode Poisson's ratio
equation_or_rule: 0.25 default, swept 0.22-0.28 (Bonkile2024)
limitations: borrowed constant
downstream_use: DFN mechanics

equation_or_rule: 2.7778e-7 s^-1 (OKane2022); shipped bug used 1e-3 (3600x too fast)
limitations: published constant for a similar cell family, not measured
downstream_use: stress-driven LAM in the DFN

equation_or_rule: 1e-12 m/s (OKane2022); shipped bug used 1e-15
limitations: published constant
downstream_use: SEI submodel
